interpretation: Actual HTTP input IDs, verified against the native resident-session identities, expose numerical gaps hidden by functional response/SSE checks. Plain q5 diverges at zero-based output index7; q17 diverges at index9 after the first EOS; q294 tool call passes all32 and logit tolerance. Tool-continuation q85 matches all32 but differs in first raw logit by0.5. Thinking q19 differs at index303 before first EOS and has first-logit error0.25. Both main cold512 cases retain every frozen output, first logit and real callback. The q8192 first callback is58785.9958ms, above the immutable4187.415605ms and outer10s targets. Short prefill/continuation boundaries are being localized without changing tokens, tolerance or release criteria.
